name: Illiyana Moonblaze
summary: At Silverwing Grove, Illiyana Moonblaze supplies the Alliance champions fighting the Warsong Outriders. She works alongside the Silverwing Sentinels in Ashenvale.

sections.title: Silverwing Supply Officer
sections.body: Illiyana Moonblaze keeps supplies for the Silverwing Sentinels at Silverwing Grove. Her post is near the path into Warsong Gulch, where she outfits defenders holding Ashenvale's southern woods against the Warsong clan.

sections.title: Supplies for the Front Lines
sections.body: Illiyana equips Alliance volunteers preparing to fight the Warsong clan in Warsong Gulch. As champions earn favor with the Silverwing Sentinels, she provides custom rations, specialized draughts, and fine weapons for woodland skirmishes. She also repairs weapons and armor for weary fighters returning from the front, keeping the Sentinels supplied for war.

faq.q: Where can I find Illiyana Moonblaze?
faq.answer: Illiyana Moonblaze is at Silverwing Grove in southeastern Ashenvale, near the staging grounds and portal leading into Warsong Gulch.

faq.q: Is Illiyana Moonblaze a member of the Sentinels?
faq.answer: Illiyana Moonblaze works alongside the Silverwing Sentinels as their supply officer, outfitting Alliance champions who fight beside them.

faq.q: What does Illiyana offer to Alliance champions?
faq.answer: Illiyana Moonblaze offers care packages, battlefield weapons, armor, rings, tabards, and consumables to champions who gain favor with the Silverwing Sentinels.
Yes. Illiyana Moonblaze repairs weapons and armor for Alliance defenders resting at the grove, as well as supplying specialized military gear.

faq.q: What care packages does she hand out?
faq.answer: Illiyana Moonblaze gives Alliance fighters Sentinel Basic, Standard, and Advanced Care Packages through her supply work, providing frontline defenders with essential battlefield provisions.

angles.text: As an Alliance fighter marching south toward the contested border of Warsong Gulch, you can look to Illiyana Moonblaze for weapons, armor, and rations.
As a night elf, you can see Illiyana Moonblaze keeping the Silverwing Sentinels supplied as the kaldorei rally to safeguard Ashenvale.
